title: Space hearts stop re-deforming off screen (W5, re-run as the scene-bench example)
runtimeWriters: SpaceCrystalAnimator.Update writes two blend-shape weights every frame (SpaceCrystalAnimator.cs:93-106); nothing writes updateWhenOffscreen on these crystals; the prefabs author it on (CrystalSpace.prefab m_UpdateWhenOffscreen 1).
exposure: Every Space heart: Garland menu world (6-12), fauna-heavy cells (~80 in Wildlife Liberation).
note: W5 has shipped, so the spawned hearts already turn updateWhenOffscreen off in Awake; offscreenAOn puts A back to the state before W5.
